This was my first visit to Cafe Poco since its renewal. I tried the new signature menu Oreno. A drink topped with acidic espresso and orange sorbet. reviews.author: faster
reviews.text:
Cafe Poco’s recommended signature is Poco a Poco.
Use Kinto glass. I think the amount is a bit small, but when I drink it,
Just one drink is good.  The coffee is topped with matcha cream and cocoa powder on top.
The taste of sweet, green tea-scented matcha cream, coffee liquid flowing down the back of your throat, and cocoa powder... But why is this so delicious?
Did coffee and matcha latte go so well together? I wonder if races with caffeine have formed their own alliance.
I order it every time I go, but it takes time to make. Moreover, if a part-timer makes it, it is easy to make a mistake.   There should be no confusion as to whether it is caffeinated or decaf, packaged or eaten in the hall. The amount of cream is also made accurately using a scale, so it is not a drink that can be completed with just one shot.

Anyway, Poko a Poko was so delicious that I wanted to make it at home.

reviews.author: y ee
reviews.text:
I heard that The Venti opened near Gachon University Gil Hospital in Guwol-dong, so I went there to try it out. There were a lot of people and the store was almost full. I was looking forward to adding pearls to the cookie frappe, but no matter how long I waited, mine didn't come out. The people in front of me got their drinks wrong so they were making them again, and the people who were trying to drink them were saying things like, ‘When will it come out?’ and ‘This is not what I ordered.’
After waiting for over 20 minutes, I finally received my drink and looked at it, but it didn't seem to have pearls, so I inquired just in case, but as expected, they made it wrong again. He said he would do it again, and while I was watching how they made it outside, he removed the top of the already made cookie frappe with a spoon and added the freshly cooked pearls and mixed them randomly... The toppings were already ruined and the pearls were on the top when they should have been on the bottom... I wondered why I had to pay for this drink. I didn't dare say I would cancel the payment, so I took it and ate it, but some of the pearls were ripe and some were not, so I wondered what it tasted like. I ate the pearls for the sake of my appetite, but they melted and were hard, which was the polar opposite.
I saw pearls being cooked for a while and they were done using a steamer. You're selling bubble tea without knowing how much or how to cook the pearls, but you're just wasting my money. It didn't taste good and the pearls weren't that good, so I ended up throwing away half of it..ㅜ I understand that you're not good at it because it's your first time, but I was very offended because I ate a cookie frappe that didn't even apologize, ruined its shape, and had pearls that weren't properly cooked. After seeing Aladdin 4DX for a long time, I was very happy, but I was really satisfied with just one drink. Cookie frappe was my favorite dish and I bought it from many places and tried it, but it's really hard to describe what I ate today. From now on, I'll just have to go to the cafe I always buy it from. I'm posting this because I'm so upset.

reviews.author: チカ（チカぷ）
reviews.text:
【Cospa is the best place to go! Korean Cafe & Coffee]

Good size! It tastes good! I love Cospa!
This Korean cafe chain is so good it brought me to tears!
Among them, I expose the outrageous yellow guy who makes me happy in mega size everywhere in the province~♪

The big missing cafe in Seoul this time is Mega Coffee, a huge coffee chain founded in 2015.

This coffee is also known as the location for the popular Korean drama “Queen of Tears” (I Like Love❤). By the way, the location store is “Mega Coffee Ishimura Lake Intersection.”

Whatever it is, it's big! ! !
Anyway, it's cheap so you can drink it anytime!
Come on, chincha is delicious! ! !
It's cheap but really delicious♡

It is said that the culture of drinking coffee has become established in Korea, which is known even in countries where coffee consumption is approximately three to four times the world average.

Surely, there are so many cafes that they have become part of the cityscape, and how many times have you seen Koreans gather there for breakfast or lunch? (laugh).

I also like coffee, so when I travel, I enjoy the menus and flavors of local chain stores and popular cafes, but there are many convenience stores in Japan.

There are also chain restaurants with a uniquely Japanese teahouse style, such as Komeda Coffee Shop and Ueshima Coffee Shop, but they are not found everywhere.
The simple reason is that in Japan, convenience stores are always nearby (laughs).

Although there are Starbana cafes everywhere in Korea, independent chain stores are everywhere, so they are extremely convenient, and they are cheap and impressive!

Americano, which is popular among Koreans, has an unbelievable service price of 150 yen for hot and 200 yen for ice! What's more, it's the same size as Staba's Venti (590ml), so it's surprising! ! !

As the name suggests, the size is large, and the “BIG SIZE 2SHOT” espresso written on the cup has a great flavor with less acidity!

There is absolutely no store like this in Japan that offers 100% Arabica beans, cheap, and guaranteed to taste great! (I brought you back~ Lee♪)

Menus other than coffee are also attractive!
The drink made with fruit that my husband missed was also delicious! Rich but not too sweet and clean.

● Blueberry Yogurt Smoothie
●Tangeline Jelly Smoothie
●Gold Kiwi Juice

The only reason it looks small in the picture is because my megalate is 1 liter (laughs).

There are about 139 kinds of drinks in total, including variations such as cafe latte and cafe mocha, decafe menus, fruit juices, smoothies, and fluff drinks, so it's fun to look at the menu, but I find myself getting lost (laughs).

Payment is made at a “kiosk”.
Kiosk refers to a touch panel type automatic payment terminal and unmanned information terminal in Korean. It has been introduced in a wide range of places, including cafes and restaurants, and has been an excellent device that enables various services such as ordering and payment to be carried out smartly.
If you want to pay in cash, you pay cash by verbal order at the counter.

In the Dongdaemun area where I was staying, there are 2 stores close to the hotel.
There was a Dongdaemun branch and a Gwanghui-dong branch.
The photo is from the Gwanghui-dong branch.

It is very crowded with Koreans in the morning and during the day, but there is also a small eat-in space, and I really liked the smiling faces of the friendly clerks.

The Dongdaemun branch specializes in takeout. Due to its location, there are many travelers, and it is open until around 11:00 at night (even later on weekends), so it was convenient to stop by after dinner.

They say they operate under the slogan, “Bigger, tastier, big-sized coffee of superior quality at a reasonable price,” but now this is a round of applause♪

It was a cafe that I felt like I wanted to drink immediately even after returning to Japan. Be sure to experience Korean cafe culture while you are in Korea♡

Store evaluation is ⭐︎⭐︎⭐︎⭐︎⭐︎
It seemed a little inconvenient that there was no bathroom, but the overall calm atmosphere was cozy.

——————

reviews.text:
I happened to see an interview with the owner on YouTube and thought I should give it a try.
I happened to have something to go to, so I drove for a long time on a rainy Tuesday, and when I saw this cafe and the nearby neighborhood, I thought that the coffee was really delicious. We are surviving in a place where it seems like there aren't many people who want to drink coffee shop, let alone specialty coffee.
There is no place to park nearby. Somehow, I parked the car and sat down at the bar opposite the barista. Instead of ordering anything else, I ordered coffee brewed using the blended beans named after the cafe.
The coffee was delicious. However, I wouldn't go out of my way to a corner of a residential area where parking is difficult just to taste the coffee, so I decided to go again next time. Although the surrounding scenery is actually an insignificant neighborhood, I could see the sincerity of the barista making the coffee and feel the warmth contained in the iced green tangerine tea that was given to me to taste. Moreover, the sight of the owner talking intimately with various customers is the right answer.
This is how coffee is supposed to be drunk.
